captions: Thursday, 5:52 p.m. The crane stops. Helmets come off.
Tomorrow is Friday. Again, you won't ask for the hour.
“The foreman won't like it.” You've said that for months.
Then Yusuf, the new guy, walks straight up to him.
“Tomorrow at one, I'm at Jumu'ah. I'll make up the time.”
The foreman just nods. That's all it ever took.
Friday, 1:10 p.m. Dust still on your boots, you join the row.
The hands that carried bricks all week, raised: “Allahu Akbar.”
Forty-five minutes. The wall still went up that day.
